evidence.detail: The exact v308 internal class name is rs/cache/osrs/util/OsrsMapDependencyScanner; the readable semantic name survives verbatim rather than being reconstructed.

The class preserves the exact usage string 'Usage: OsrsMapDependencyScanner [cache-directory] [maps.yaml] [report.txt]' and reports exit semantics for clean scans, dependency findings and incomplete setup/error states.

Exact strings describe an 'OSRS map dependency scan', missing definitions, missing sequences, missing or invalid frame/keyframe files, landscape decode errors, spawned objects and recursive dependencyObject findings.

It writes the default report path dumps/osrs-map-dependencies.txt, preserves report-safety checks, and emits a findings report grouped by region/root object/dependency together with clean-scan text 'No missing dependencies found.'.
